name: omnicore
description: Claudio Schirmer's marketplace for omnicore framework tooling.

plugins.name: omnicore
plugins.description: Scaffold services & entities, decompose a whole-system/MVP into a domain map and scaffold it entity by entity, evolve or remove existing entities, create and evolve read-side views, wire framework capabilities docs-first, convert the infrastructure posture reversibly (MVP ⇄ full CQRS, engine/transport swaps), run the service with clickable links, generate and run a contract QA suite, diagnose a misbehaving service, run a generator command against an existing project, upgrade the framework pin, and get docs-first help — invoked as /omnicore:scaffold-service, /omnicore:scaffold-system, /omnicore:scaffold-entity, /omnicore:omnicore-gen, /omnicore:gen, /omnicore:evolve-entity, /omnicore:remove-entity, /omnicore:scaffold-view, /omnicore:evolve-view, /omnicore:implement, /omnicore:configure, /omnicore:run, /omnicore:qa, /omnicore:doctor, /omnicore:upgrade, /omnicore:help.
